title: Exploring 1,3-dioxolane polymerization initiated by NOPF6: a universal approach to self-solidifying electrolytes for high-capacity retention potassium batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2072-2078
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01421A, Paper
Elena V. Shchurik, Yuriy Baluda, Olga A. Kraevaya, Sergey M. Aldoshin, Pavel A. Troshin
An effective approach to potassium batteries with a self-solidifying polymer electrolyte by the addition of NOPF6 directly into the cell was proposed.
